title: Admin routes moved out of the auth middleware group
description: Admin routes are lifted out of the middleware group while reorganising routes/web.php, leaving them without authentication or the admin gate.
context: The 'can:admin' gate is defined in AuthServiceProvider. No other middleware is applied to these routes elsewhere; the controller does not perform its own checks.

expected_findings.description: The admin routes no longer run the 'auth' and 'can:admin' middleware, exposing user administration endpoints to unauthenticated requests.
